description: This Java source file defines a utility class GeoLocationUtils that provides a method for retrieving the client's IP address from an HTTP request, considering various headers that may contain the IP due to proxy usage.

classes.name: GeoLocationUtils
classes.description: A utility class for extracting the client's IP address from an HTTP request.

methods.name: getClientIpAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the client's IP address from the request headers, checking various proxies headers; defaults to request.getRemoteAddr() if none of these headers contain the IP.
